Macklemore's 'Free Palestine' chant prompts calls for removal from tour

Singer Macklemore's on-stage chant of "Free Palestine" during a performance has led to a petition demanding his removal as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's tour. An Israeli-US organization has also called for his removal. The Independent reported on the petition, while The Jerusalem Post noted the organization's appeal.
